topic: Correcting data processing and analytics pipeline
summary_markdown:
The session focused on debugging issues with the ClickHouse (CH) data pipeline, specifically concerning data visibility and processing accuracy.

Initial troubleshooting involved checking which jobs were writing to CH. It was determined that a configuration issue caused some queries to run in read-only mode or fail silently when executed from an IDE/client on different nodes compared to the main server.

This required re-running the full data recalculation (`recalc`) process, as initial runs had only partially processed the sessions. The team confirmed that after restarting multiple CH servers and running the specific `recalc` job, the session data was correctly updated.

Later, a temporary loss of yesterday's traffic data was identified and resolved by someone, confirming that all necessary data streams were back online and fully processed. The process concluded with confirmation that the data could be written to JCD.
decisions: The full recalculation job (`recalc`) must be re-run due to initial processing errors and configuration issues.
CH servers needed multiple restarts to resolve connectivity/read-only mode errors.
Data was confirmed as fully processed and ready for writing to JCD.
action_items: The user will temporarily remove the `recalc` job from the general job schedule before running it, then restore it later.
Someone needs to write data into JCD (JCD team).
